ANALYSIS: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease is a hereditary structural renal disorder characterized by multiple bilateral renal cysts and progressive renal enlargement/failure. Nephrolithiasis (ureteral stone) is an acute/urologic obstructive condition causing colic. They are distinct diagnoses (one is a chronic genetic cystic disease; the other is an acute stone event), so the prediction is not equivalent.
